heading: cyUpload rent statement

contentBlocks.text: cyYou must upload a rent statement so the court and the defendant can see the amount of rent arrears you are claiming

bullets: cythe dates and amounts of all missed payments
cya running total of the rent arrears

contentBlocks.text: cy1. Upload your rent statement now: cyUpload the rent statement that is up to date today.
cy2. Upload an updated statement: cyYou must upload an updated rent statement the day before the hearing. It must include any new payments or arrears that have happened since your first statement.
cyThe court will use your updated statement to make sure it has the most up to date information about the rent arrears you are claiming.
cyGive your document a name that explains what it is. For example, ‘Rent statement up to 16 May 2025’.

uploadHint: cyYou can upload a PDF, Word (DOCX) or Excel (XLSX) file. Each file must be smaller than 20MB.
